sara: Heads up — I hit a typing mismatch in the Python SDK sampleapp when using streaming chat. mypy fails even though runtime works. quick repro below.

sara: ```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()
async def main():
    async for chunk in client.stream_chat("gpt-4o", messages=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]):
        print(chunk)
```

sara: mypy output: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "AsyncGenerator[Any, None]", variable has type "AsyncIterator[str]").

mike: which sdk version?

sara: sdk==0.12.3

alex: looks familiar — last release we changed internal stream to yield StreamChunk objects (AsyncGenerator[StreamChunk, None]) but the published stubs still claim AsyncIterator[str]. a mismatch.

jin: pyright tends to be quiet here but mypy strict flags catch it. could be the autogen pydantic model uses Optional[Union[str, List[str]]] so types end up different at runtime.

sara: excerpt from autogenerated models.py: ```py
class StreamChunk(BaseModel):
    content: Optional[Union[str, List[str]]]
```

sara: sometimes the client yields plain str for simple text-only responses, sometimes a StreamChunk dict. stubs only cover the plain-str case.

mike: can someone make a minimal repro and open an issue? please include mypy config and sdk version. @alex

alex: pinged. I can put up a patch: change public typing to AsyncIterator[Union[str, StreamChunk]] and add overloads so sync vs async variants are clear. also add tests for mypy with strict config.

sara: will that be backwards compatible for users who already treat chunks as str?

alex: runtime will keep yielding str for text-only streams (no behavior change). typing update just reflects the reality: structured chunks are an option. we should document and add a deprecation note if we ever stop yielding plain str.

jin: alternative: generate .pyi stubs from the autogen model code so types stay in sync instead of hand-editing stubs. might help avoid drift.

mike: ok action items: sara -> minimal reproducible example with mypy config; alex -> draft PR updating typing + tests; jin -> explore autogenerated .pyi generation; I'll file the issue and link PRs.

ci-bot: build passed on branch fix/stream-typing-187210 (CI: :white_check_mark:)

sara: thanks y'all :thumbsup:

mike: one more note — we also observed an auth/retry edge-case where the stream errors mid-yield and client retry logic can emit mixed chunk types. add that to the issue.

alex: noted, will add test simulating mid-stream error + retry to ensure types stay consistent.

sara: great, leaving repro and logs in the issue thread.
